brand.name: AMIFIBER
brand.tagline: Providing the Backbone of Digital Connectivity.
brand.sub_tagline: High-capacity fiber infrastructure connecting data centers, carriers, cloud platforms, ISPs, and enterprises across Southeast Asia.
brand.positioning: Southeast Asia B2B wholesale fiber infrastructure provider (Jakarta, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand). Dedicated carrier-grade infrastructure, NOT a residential ISP.

aesthetic_archetype.theme_mode: Predominantly Crisp White & Clean Corporate Blue (70% White/Light, 20% Deep Corporate Blue, 10% Network/Sky Blue)
aesthetic_archetype.design_personality: Minimal, architectural, precise, reliable, ultra-clean corporate B2B telecom infrastructure. Zero neon gimmicks, zero SaaS-slop floating blobs, zero cheap gradients. Real technical network visualizations, 1px precision grid dividers, deep fiber photographic realism, and calm high-contrast typography.
forbidden_patterns: Neon purple/cyan glow or cyberpunk tropes
Excessive glassmorphism or muddy blurry cards
Residential ISP tropes like speed tests or home WiFi imagery
Generic template card soup with identical box shadows

layout_and_grids.grid_philosophy: Swiss Grid with 1px hairline borders (#DCE7EF), generous spacing (py-24 to py-32), crisp edges, and zero visual clutter.
layout_and_grids.hero_layout: Full viewport hero (min-h-screen) with subtle cinematic dark blue gradient overlay on fiber/data center visual, left-aligned architectural typography, primary and secondary CTA buttons, no floating cards, and subtle vertical line indicator.
layout_and_grids.statistics_layout: Horizontal row with thin vertical border separators (#DCE7EF), animated count-up once, 4 metrics on desktop, 2x2 grid on mobile.
layout_and_grids.network_map_layout: Full interactive Southeast Asian SVG network schematic on #F3F7FB. Nodes: Jakarta, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur/Malaysia, Bangkok/Thailand, Batam. Live animated pulsed fiber lines with legend: Live Network, Planned Build, Data Center, PoP.
layout_and_grids.services_layout: Editorial alternating numbered rows (01 Dark Fiber, 02 Custom Network Infrastructure, 03 Data Center Interconnection) with high-detail technical specs and real photographic fiber infrastructure imagery.
layout_and_grids.solutions_grid: Modular 6-card grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with 1px solid border (#DCE7EF), subtle hover lift, technical monochrome line icons with blue accenting.
layout_and_grids.why_amifiber_layout: Deep corporate blue (#003B73) full section, large crisp white typography, hairline semi-transparent borders (#164E87), 6 pillar blocks with zero cards for high authoritative weight.
layout_and_grids.connectivity_diagram_layout: Horizontal technical engineering path diagram: Data Center -> Metro Fiber Network -> AMIFIBER Regional Backbone -> Cross-Border Terrestrial/Subsea -> International Gateway -> Cloud/ISP/CDN with animated traveling data pulses.
layout_and_grids.contact_form_layout: Crisp two-column B2B infrastructure layout on pure white: direct enterprise dispatch details and operational centers on the left; structured enterprise RFQ form on the right with Service dropdown and validation.

Deep blue (#002B55) corporate footer with 4 link columns (Network & Coverage, Infrastructure Solutions, Regulatory & Compliance, Regional Operations), brand statement, copyright, and emergency NOC hotline.

testing_attributes.protocol: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, and key indicators must have kebab-case data-testid attributes.

framer_motion_rules: Scroll reveal: opacity 0 -> 1, translateY 20px -> 0 with transition duration 0.6s - 0.8s and easeOut.
Stats counter: uses Framer Motion animate hook to smoothly increment numbers upon viewport entry.
Network map pulses: SVG circular pulses with subtle stroke-dashoffset / stroke-dasharray animations.
Card hover: subtle 1-2px translateY lift with crisp border color shift from #DCE7EF to #0057B8.
Image hover: max scale 1.02 over 0.5s ease.
Accessibility: honor prefers-reduced-motion using useReducedMotion() hook.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a JavaScript project with .js and .jsx files (not .tsx). Do not write TypeScript types in component code.
Follow the exact corporate BLUE + WHITE color identity specified. Never use purple or cyan neon gradients.
Ensure the hero has a robust dark blue gradient overlay (max opacity bg-black/60 with #002B55 gradient) so the white text has pristine APCA contrast.
Render the Southeast Asian network map using an SVG illustration with Jakarta, Singapore, Batam, Kuala Lumpur, and Bangkok accurately positioned.
Ensure all forms use controlled state and provide prompt feedback via sonner toast upon submission.
Never use generic centered layouts across the board; enforce Swiss editorial asymmetric rhythms with 1px borders and ample padding.
Attach data-testid to every interactive button, menu, input, and key statistic.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered cards, AI gradients, and floating emojis. Build authoritative, engineered Swiss infrastructure aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Manrope for all headings and Inter for all body text. Never default to plain Inter for headers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy: use py-24 or py-32 for section breathing room.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Specific transitions only. Never use transition: all.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all copy against surfaces.
